scope: Read-only review of B01 plan revision v4, including the record-size rule added after v3 review. Product implementation and TC tests are assessed separately from this plan verdict.

v3_json_pointer_clarification.details: Both issues[].path and configuration.unresolved_paths are explicitly JSON Pointer, with array indices and unknown keys omitted as stated. Dot notation is prose-only. This gives TC and API callers one consistent path oracle.

snapshot_size_boundary.details: Canonical record UTF-8 bytes plus final LF must be at most 2 MiB. createSnapshot rejects a larger record with PROFILE_VERSION_INVALID, accepts exactly 2 MiB, and uses the remaining envelope budget rather than inventing a separate profileVersion length rule. P2 now calls for an independent 2 MiB boundary vector at ±1 byte. A successfully returned snapshot is therefore persistable under the store's size limit.

scope_and_identity.details: B01 remains registry, profile/workflow validators, and immutable snapshots. The workflow bundle binds exact raw hashes for workflow/state/agent source files; Job.workflow_version resolves through immutable workflow_id while schema_version remains a document-format version. B02 identity/authorization/workspaces and B03 durable Temporal/outbox execution remain separate.

profile_and_authority.details: The new profile schema is clearly implementation-authored. Required fields match the source example. Five empty real-configuration arrays, marker rules, and uniform release-mode handling are explicit. Mock/real configuration, external smoke checks, and approvals remain separate; configured does not mean approved or executable.

publication_and_recovery.details: The fixed create-once hardlink flow, file and directory sync requirements, EEXIST idempotency barrier, corruption detection, uncertain result handling, retry, and no-rollback rules continue to follow senior advice. Local filesystem and power-loss limitations are stated.

verification_and_gate_skip.details: P0-P6 define purpose, target, method, owner, pass evidence, and recovery. TC uses independent literal expectations and pinned vectors. The existing UI gate skip remains conditional on matching source inventory and build/plugin outputs against the exact accepted controls archive, gate, review evidence, and baseline pins; any mismatch expands verification.

original_acceptance_boundary.details: Full AT-04 and AT-28 remain unexecuted until their end-to-end skip-evidence and real-release behaviors exist. B01 evidence does not count as B01-B05 or original AT acceptance.

implementation_follow_up: This verdict approves the plan only. The current initial implementation was observed to lack the new createSnapshot size check; it must implement the exact rule and pass the independent P2/CLI boundary evidence before code review can approve it.
reviewer_verdict: Approved for implementation after the separate TC plan review is recorded against this exact plan SHA.
